project.objective: What children were born to Benjamín Silva Díaz and Clara González Pimienta in Chile, 1890–1910?

researcher_profile.narration_guidance: Explain findings clearly and simply, as if to someone new to genealogy research.

questions.question: What children were born to Benjamín Silva Díaz and Clara González Pimienta in Chile, 1890–1910?
questions.rationale: The couple Benjamín Silva Díaz (I1) and Clara González Pimienta (I2) lived in Nancagua, Colchagua, Chile around 1890. Chile civil registration records would identify their children born in that period.

items.rationale: Enumerate all children of Benjamín Silva Díaz and Clara González Pimienta in FamilySearch Chile civil registration (collection 1410964). The couple lived in Nancagua; search their birth registrations there.
